title: colchicum crocifolium var. stenanthum
intro: Colchicum crocifolium var. stenanthum, commonly known as Autumn Crocus, is a plant species belonging to the Colchicum genus, characterized by its cup-shaped flowers and narrow leaves. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that help alleviate pain and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Autumn Crocus are attributed to its ability to inhibit cell division and mitosis, making it a potential treatment for certain types of cancer and rheumatoid arthritis. The bioactive constituents of Autumn Crocus include colchicine, a glycoside responsible for its medicinal properties, which also contributes to its toxic effects if ingested in large quantities.
